content:
zoe: Follow-up from the postmortem — we agreed several small runbook/playbook edits and owners. Dropping action list so we can close RW-INC-4975.

hari: I'll own the recurring-pattern detection changes (alerts + a short doc on what to look for). Will stub a Grafana alert for kv_miss_rate and p95 drift. ETA 2026-04-10.

jin: I'll take the triage checklist and the quick-collect script. Plan: add a 1-page TL;DR at top of the runbook and a `tools/incident_collect.sh` with 5 commands. PR by Mon.

abby: I'll update escalation steps and add exact PagerDuty service names + a 2-step exec notify process. Also will add the "when to page" box with explicit thresholds. PR by Thu.

zoe: Proposed thresholds to put in playbook: sustained p95 increase >10% for >8m OR error_rate >0.8% for >4m. If agreed, abby add to PD snippet.

jin: Agreed. Example quick-collect commands I'll include:
```bash
# metrics snapshot
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/metrics | tail -n 40
# model cache summary
redis-cli -u redis://redis-main:6379 HGETALL model_cache_summary
```
Also will annotate which fields to check (queue_depth, kv_hit_rate, model_load_time_ms).

hari: Found recurring pattern note: several incidents start within 10 minutes of deploy + cache flush. I'll add a deploy-check checklist item and a link to the prewarm job.

ops-bot: Created issue RW-INC-4975: "runbook/playbook edits - triage, escalation, recurring-patterns". Assigned to jin, hari, abby. Due 2026-04-10.

zoe: Final owners/due dates: jin - triage checklist + incident_collect.sh (PR Mon 2026-03-30), hari - recurring-pattern alerts + dashboard (ETA 2026-04-10), abby - escalation matrix + PD mapping (PR Thu 2026-04-02). We'll do a 15-min review Fri 09:00. Add blockers here.

jin: Starting the PR today, tagging @abby and @hari.

abby: I'll draft PD mapping and the short "how to verify remediation" checklist (p50/p95 heatmap + kv_hit_rate stable 20m).

zoe: Thanks team — once PRs merge we'll close RW-INC-4975 and note the follow-up in the postmortem. :rocket:
